metadata.summary: A multi-center intensive care unit database with records from 200,859 ICU admissions from 139,367 unique patients at 208 hospitals in the United States between 2014 and 2015. Includes vital signs, care plan documentation, medications, laboratory measurements, and severity of illness scores.
metadata.purpose: To support collaborative multi-center research, external validation, and federated learning of clinical models.

papers.title: eICU Collaborative Research Database, a freely available multi-center database for critical care research

ethics.privacy_measures: De-identification performed per HIPAA Safe Harbor method; no protected health information retained.

extraction.notes: 基线卡仅来自 dataset_catalog.xlsx 真实元数据；其余字段需论文/README 或人工补充。

known_limitations: Limited to US hospitals (208 centers), potentially limiting generalizability to non-US or resource-limited settings.
Data restricted to 2014–2015; may not reflect current practices, technologies, or disease patterns.
No explicit reporting on demographic representation (race, ethnicity, sex, age distribution).
Potential selection bias due to voluntary hospital participation and exclusion of non-participating ICUs.
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Data de-identified and harmonized; no synthetic data generation reported.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: US-only, 2014–2015, 208 participating hospitals — may not represent global or evolving ICU practice.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Designed for multi-center generalization and external validation within similar US academic/community ICU settings; limited generalizability outside this domain and timeframe.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No subgroup coverage statistics provided in source text.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Missingness patterns not quantified in abstract; known to exist in EHR-derived fields (e.g., labs, vitals).

data_origin.selection_rationale: Records selected from de-identified ICU admissions across participating US hospitals to enable multi-center critical care research.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Consecutive ICU admissions from 208 US hospitals during 2014–2015; no explicit sampling strategy beyond temporal and institutional inclusion.
data_origin.aggregation_multisource: Aggregated from 208 US hospitals; data harmonized and curated for consistency.
data_origin.data_shifts_overtime: Data collected only from 2014–2015; no longitudinal or multi-version shift analysis reported.

population.target_population: Adult and pediatric ICU patients in the United States.
population.inclusion_criteria: ICU admission at a participating hospital during 2014–2015.
population.missing_groups: No explicit reporting on underrepresented groups (e.g., race/ethnicity, age subgroups, rural vs. urban); abstract states 'no explicit demographic subgroup statistics'.

annotation.annotation_method: Derived from structured EHR fields (e.g., ICD-9 codes, lab results, vitals, nursing notes).
annotation.labeling_provenance: Labels extracted from clinical documentation and coded data within the EHR system.

benchmarks: eICU benchmark tasks (e.g., mortality prediction, length-of-stay estimation)
tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Commercial applications; real-time clinical decision support without further validation.
